page_title: Your Focus already silences your phone. Now it silences your menu bar.

summary.name: Nocturne
summary.one_liner: A free-to-use, MIT-licensed macOS menu bar utility that hides or obscures the menu bar clock (and optionally the whole bar) automatically when a Focus such as Do Not Disturb is on.
use_cases: Stop seeing the clock while working a deep focus block
Sync Do Not Disturb from iPhone to hide the Mac menu bar
Hide cluttered menu bar icons during focus sessions
Reveal the time on demand with hover-to-show
Learn how to build macOS Focus-aware apps without extra permissions
summary.what_it_does: Nocturne is a Focus filter: once added under System Settings > Focus > Add Filter, turning on a Focus on any device signed into the same iCloud account changes the Mac menu bar. It offers five modes: normal clock, Blind (switches the clock to an unreadable analog dial via a Control Center preference), Gone (draws a patch over the clock), Hide everything (blanks the bar but keeps clicks passing through), and Only the clock. It restores the previous mode when the Focus ends, and leaves manual mode changes alone during a Focus. The page also documents measurements and pitfalls around macOS Focus APIs, Full Disk Access, Screen Recording and window-name visibility.
notable: Works as a macOS Focus filter, so it needs no Full Disk Access, Accessibility, Screen Recording or Focus permission
Blind mode makes the clock analog and unreadable at 44pt width instead of hiding it, since Apple offers no visibility toggle for the clock
Hover-to-show reveals the covered bar while the pointer is over it
Detailed write-up of macOS pitfalls: TCC-protected DoNotDisturb store, silent INFocusStatusCenter failures, and kCGWindowName gated by Screen Recording
caveats: Gone mode leaves a faint seam over the translucent Tahoe menu bar
Tested only on macOS 26; macOS 14 and 15 are compiled and symbol-checked but never run
Does not manage individual menu bar items; use Ice for per-icon control
Does not cover full-screen Spaces unless the menu bar is set to stay visible there
